name: SYS-DAT S.p.A.
summary: SYS-DAT S.p.A. operates as an information and communication technology company in Italy and internationally. It offers information technology (IT) solutions in the areas of business intelligence, cloud services, customer relationship management, retail and sales digital suite, energy control, digital commerce, electronic data interchange, enterprise resource planning, general data protection regulation and privacy, and document management and networking.
